summary: Automation engine: call nodes run in automation.call child instances with retries, masking and blocked unknown outcomes (Operations.Resolve/Retry); ask nodes with correlation tokens; connector inbound (outbox publish with dedup, webhook handler, poller, collect windows) and loop protection (include_self); human node with quorum, escalation and automation.task.assigned.v1; BuildRunContext with subject.url and run.url; dry run with node DryRun modes and a decision cache, and test node.
